lines: GTA 6 took thirteen years... because somebody had to make this trash can.
Then this bench. This palm tree.
Now do it for an entire state.
Every object starts as a grey cube. Model it. Unwrap it. Texture it.
Then multiply that by every alley in fake Florida.
Then the people. Rockstar opened an entire office just for NPCs.
Every one needs a skeleton, so their elbows don't fold like lawn chairs.
And animating them? An even longer, freaking process.
Red Dead 2 had three hundred thousand animations.
Walk. Run. Trip. Get hit by a car. Every one cleaned up by hand.
Then you finally hit play... and the car falls through the map.
Fix one bug, three more spawn.
Meanwhile they shipped Red Dead 2, and re-released GTA 5. Twice.
4,700 people. Eight years of development. One game.
So sketch it, and Vi3W turns it into a rigged 3D model you can animate.
